extras: The plugin is one-way, manual, and does not sync automatically or read files outside the vault.
intentEvidence: Send selected notes to DM Kit so your campaign tools and Lorekeeper can use them.
problem: Dungeon Masters need a way to link their detailed campaign notes and lore directly into their dedicated campaign management tools.
